settings.heading: Will this stop hair shedding from my GLP-1 medication?
settings.row_content: No supplement can guarantee an end to medication-related shedding. Goodwell Spermidine provides an ingredient studied for supporting the natural growing phase of the hair cycle. It offers proactive biological support, not a proven cure for GLP-1 side effects.

settings.heading: How long does hair biology take to shift?
settings.row_content: Hair cycles change slowly. The preliminary human study on oral spermidine measured markers of the growing phase after 90 days of consistent use. Supporting your follicles is a steady habit, not an overnight cosmetic fix.

settings.heading: Can I take this with my weight-loss prescription?
settings.row_content: Always consult your prescribing doctor before adding any supplement to your routine, especially when taking medications that alter your metabolism or weight. We do not promise compatibility with specific prescription drugs.

settings.heading: What exactly is in the capsule?
settings.row_content: Each two-capsule serving contains 10 mg of Spermidine 3HCL. The only other ingredients are an HPMC capsule and rice flour. There are no hidden proprietary blends.

settings.heading: How do I use this product?
settings.row_content: Take two capsules daily with water. You can easily integrate this quick step into your existing morning or evening routine alongside your other daily habits.

settings.heading: Is this a recurring subscription?
settings.row_content: No. All options on this page are one-time purchases processed through our secure Shopify checkout. You only buy what you choose today, with no automatic rebilling or hidden subscription commitments.
